featured_reviews.name: Keya Phatnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have been using Healkin for the past 6 months for both home nursing support and caregiver services, and our experience has been consistently excellent. The staff has been professional, compassionate, dependable, and extremely patient in handling day-to-day care needs.

What truly stands out is the responsiveness and sense of responsibility of their coordination team. On one occasion, due to an unforeseen last-minute issue with the scheduled nurse for the next day, Krithika went the extra mile late at night and arranged a replacement to ensure there was absolutely no disruption in care. That level of commitment and ownership gave us tremendous peace of mind.

Over the months, we have found the nurses to be clinically competent and attentive, while the caregivers have been warm, respectful, and genuinely caring towards the patient and family alike. Managing home care over an extended period can be stressful, and having a reliable agency like this has made a meaningful difference for us.

Would highly recommend Healkin to anyone looking for trustworthy home healthcare and caregiving support.

featured_reviews.name: A G
featured_reviews.review_text:
Healkin provides real good services when it comes to elderly care for male as well as female patients. The caretakers are trustworthy and stay like your family member. They check on the client and caretaker regularly to address concerns of both.
I have been using their services for quite sometime now.
Special thanks to staff supervisor: Mrs Sharda for always arranging replacement staff even on the last minute.
Thanks to coordinator: Mr Debojit for getting things sorted even as late as 12 am in the night.
Last but not the least both caretakers: Sunita and Meera did a wonderful job in taking care of my mother.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Khadatare
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent experience we had while Rekha Kumari was working as caretaker for my mother who was operated recently.  I got reference from Ms Minal of dadar of Healkin home nursing, a agency which provides caretaker / nursing help.  Right from day one, could notice perfect support   and co-ordination, when contacted Sushma and everything happened thereafter was all per promises made.. Keep the good work on.. my best wishes to entire Healkin team..

featured_reviews.name: Deepika Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience with Healkin. The caretaker, Merri Dsouza, was exceptional—she cared for my grandmother with genuine compassion, like her own mother. From daily hygiene and medicines to emotional support, she played a big role in helping a bedridden patient recover.

A special thanks to supervisor Sharda as well, who ensured there was no service disruption by arranging timely replacements whenever needed.

Overall, a very positive experience. I would highly recommend Healkin.

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Nanavati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sister Stella has helped us a lot with our 93 years old mother in the home and when mom would go to the office.
She is very pleasant and Mom has loved her company.
Even Namita who organised her services was very helpful and polite.
Only, wish you would charge the same rate as other nursing agencies, as yours is Rs 400 higher than other nursing agencies.

featured_reviews.name: Shital Pimpale
featured_reviews.review_text: Having used different bureaus for patient caretaker this is the first time came across a professional bureau who sent a caretaker who has also done basic nursing course also. Her name is shrushti from Healkin and I am very happy with their professionlism.Comes on time, does her work quietly, good at her work and she is very neat and clean and hygienic. featured_reviews.name: Monil Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: AVOID AT ALL COST!! This agency is nothing but a bunch of hooligans working together. We had a 6 month relationship during which they were paid in lakhs for their nurses. When we switched to caretaker, their service deteriorated. Firstly, they sent over someone who had no qualifications whatsoever, sat around for hours glancing at her phone and when we had her sent back for a replacement they asked for a full day's payment even when the person was physically present for less than 12 hours. We still paid for a 12 hour shift (which we shouldn't have) based on the discount approved but they claimed to not honor the same discounted rate when the service duration was reduced. After paying in lakhs, they came to our doorstep to demand ₹800 and created havoc like homeless hooligans. Their staff including Kritika and Namita (Manager) used foul language when we discussed the remainder payment. I find this agency is run by a bunch of unqualified and illiterate individuals. There is no organizational hierarchy and when asked for higher-up managers, there is no one ever present to handle such situations in a cordial manner. If you care for your loved one, I'd recommend not using any of their services.

featured_reviews.name: Anu Tewari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Happy with the service provided by Healkin (for  a nurse for My mother in law )
The Nurse Stella was  very cheerful, efficient  and competent treating the patient with dignity and kindness !  To have Stella around was a source of comfort for us all !!
The Manager Krithika was helpful, proactive & responsive . She made the care-giving service seem seamless !
Overall they both made us feel safe and cared !
Thank you to both 🙏

name: Dignity Dementia Day Care Centre, Mumbai
description:
Dementia i.e. Alzheimer’s and related disorders are getting increasingly common among senior citizens in India. Due to its progressive nature & lack of medical treatments, caring for those with Dementia is critical. In Mumbai, Dignity Foundation is successfully running a Dementia Day Care Centre, catering to the unmet needs of the city.
Our Dementia Day Care Centre is staffed with trained caregivers who provide elder care with compassion. They manage members’ mood swings, aggression & other behavioural symptoms successfully.
We offer home pick-up and drop service along with daily lunch and refreshments. Members get therapies & engage in social interactions to stay active. We have other centres in New Delhi, Pune, Kolkata and Chennai.

featured_reviews.name: Anjali Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text: During my volunteering hours, I observed how the staff managed the setting and the members with utmost care, alertness and positive energy. The manager on site is well-informed, resourceful and kind. The members benefit from the services, the weekly schedules inclusive of age and needs appropriate activities, and community. The setting is also well-maintained, safe and hygienic.

featured_reviews.name: Abigail Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful time at the dementia day care! We enjoyed playing games, doing crafts, and working on puzzles with the elders. The staff were kind, caring, and went above and beyond to ensure everyone had a great time. The 'Chai Masti' program was a highlight, with fun activities like exercise, laughter yoga, and Zumba that brought joy and laughter to all. It was a heartwarming experience for everyone involved, and we felt grateful to have shared in it.

featured_reviews.name: Kazi Ayesha Asif
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful time at the dementia day care centre. Interacting with them, organizing activities, doing exercises to keep them active. I went there as volunteer for 4 days and and really liked how it all went smoothly, the staff was kind and helpful as well. i really liked how they treated every member with kindness and respect.
The foundation also has a "Chai Masti Centre" for the elders to sit, have a cup of hot tea/coffee along with snacks and just talk. i really enjoyed spending my time here. Hoping to be able to volunteer again 🥰💗

featured_reviews.name: Kainaz & Nihal Harchandrai
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a budget friendly day care centre for dementia patients. The manager Archana along with her team are very caring, supporting and collaborative with the senior citizens. They keep all the seniors busy and engaged throughout the day with lots of activities. There has been a very positive improvement in the mental health of my family member after spending time at the centre. They have a pick up and drop off service too. I wish they could set up a centre nearer to where we live and more such centres in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: 13 Sanjana Erla
featured_reviews.review_text: As a student, I had the opportunity to visit the dementia day care centre for four days, and it was a truly meaningful experience. The staff is kind and caring, and the environment is warm and supportive. I enjoyed interacting with the residents and learning from them. It was a meaningful experience, and I appreciate the team’s efforts in making a difference. Thank you for having me!

featured_reviews.name: mehernaz marshall
featured_reviews.review_text: The dignity dementia day care centre is really doing an amazing job. I’m currently doing my sociology report for which I’ve to spend time here and the environment is so positive and loving and there’s so much care to give around here. The people helping out here are also so patient and so so giving. Headed by Archana ma’am. This programme is amazing and so helpful for the patients that come here. Filled with laughter, enjoyment and fun.

featured_reviews.name: Mitali Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came at DDC, Mahim as part my curricular activities. But after spending here time I really got attracted and enjoyed being here. Patients here are so sweet and so co-operative. Caregivers were really very helpful and kind. Last but not least Mahim branch manager Archana maam, you were so kind and sweet to us. We will miss Dementia Day Care Center Mahim alot..❤️

I was also a part of Chai Masti Centre, Mahim. Chai Masti centre member were full of energetic and inspiring. I was shocked when I saw them doing excercise, yoga, etc I was like seriously ? They were at 100% charged mode. And in the end we use to have snacks and coffee was my personal favourite time as all of us to sit together and have our snacks. I have really made alot of memories her which I will never forget.
Awaiting to come here and volunteer as soon as possible..🤗❤️

featured_reviews.name: christina bulley
featured_reviews.review_text: My dad goes to the dignity foundation dementia day care and they have great activities for persons with dementia. They engage the patients and keep them involved and have the utmost patience and understanding with the patients and understand the disease (which very few people do). There should be manv such centres open all over the city and India.

featured_reviews.name: Ilumua Q
featured_reviews.review_text:
From the very first day, when I met the husband-and-wife doctors, they spoke with sweetness, kindness, and polished manners. It all felt genuine — until the real experience began. Their staff looked polite, but the truth was clear: they were inexperienced, unskilled, and simply learning at my expense. During delivery, that lack of professionalism became painfully obvious.

When my contractions started and I reached their nursing home, it was a Sunday. Neither doctor was present. For three and a half hours, not a single doctor showed up. Only nurses were handling my case through phone calls. No real medical supervision, no urgency, no care. By the time the doctor finally arrived, my contractions had already stopped — just two minutes before they walked in.

Inside the OT, things turned from bad to humiliating. A gynaecologist should be gentle, supportive, and empathetic. Instead, he scolded me while I was in active labor. During a normal delivery, he cut without anesthesia, stitched without anesthesia, and when I reacted out of pain — as any human would — he scolded even more. No compassion, no patience, no humanity. Only authority and anger.

Even after a normal delivery, I was given so many stitches that I had to survive on liquid for three days. Because of that, my breastfeeding was destroyed. My baby never even got my milk — not because I didn’t try, but because they didn’t guide, didn’t help, and didn’t care.

When my baby was born, I kept asking what happened, how the baby was. They were careless. Even after requesting, they didn’t give skin-to-skin contact. Breastfeeding support was zero. Basic things like boiled water weren’t provided.

And behind all this poor service was the real face of this hospital: money-minded doctors.
Every step, every medicine, every test felt like a profit-making plan. They charge heavily but provide nothing close to professional care. I was admitted for four days, but they billed me for five. Medicines inside the hospital were much more expensive than outside. Their entire system feels designed to earn — not to treat.

Today, months later, I’m still paying the price. I cannot sit comfortably. Using the restroom is painful. Intimacy with my partner is still not possible. Even my menstrual flow causes discomfort. Now I’m seeing another gynaecologist to fix the damage they caused.

They charged nearly 50,000, but the experience was traumatic, careless, and far from medical standards.

In simple words: This place is run by money-minded doctors who lack empathy, professionalism, and skill. My experience was one of the worst and most painful phases of my life. I would never recommend this hospital to anyone.
